purpose: Technical preview for a 16-direction pre-rendered player with separate body and weapon layers from one shared rig and camera.
camera: strict orthographic camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees; character rotates only around the world vertical axis
facing: 16 evenly spaced azimuth directions; frame zero faces screen-right
lighting: controlled cyan rim with restrained magenta bounce; body remains opaque and readable on the dark battlefield
prompt: Create a technical game-character preview board preserving the approved compact armored player identity. Show eight evenly sampled views from a 16-direction pre-rendered system under one strict 45-degree top-down orthographic camera. Include a clear body-only, weapon-only, and correctly socketed composite demonstration. The rifle must be projected by the same camera and held naturally with both hands, never rotated as a flat side-view image. Tactical graphic illustration, clean silhouettes, no labels or text.
revision_prompt: Preserve the sheet and change only the isolated rifle: match the strict 45-degree orthographic projection and yaw of the adjacent assembled player; keep it opaque, rigid, socket-consistent, and never side-profile.
negative_constraints: no floating, orbiting, or yo-yo weapon
no identity, armor, scale, or lighting drift
no text, border artifacts, cropped anatomy, or extra characters

references.role: weapon design reference only; camera projection must change
